# School Of Freelancing

> Bangladesh-based Linux and AI freelancing training platform teaching production-ready, hands-on skills for real freelance clients.

## Main Pages
- [Linux and AI Freelancing Training](https://schooloffreelancing.com/): Join live, instructor-led freelancing training, or hire hands-on Linux technical support for businesses worldwide.

## About Us
- [About Us: School Of Freelancing](https://schooloffreelancing.com/about-us): School Of Freelancing offers live Linux and AI training with global tech support for freelancers and businesses.

## Freelancing Training
- [Bulk SMS — Setup Training](https://schooloffreelancing.com/freelancing-training/bulk-sms-setup-training): Learn how to build bulk SMS systems with SMS APIs — automate CSV messaging, deploy production workflows, land freelance clients.

- [Automate Your First Repetitive Task](https://schooloffreelancing.com/resource-center/automation): Step-by-step guide to automating business tasks: email, file processing, data entry, and scheduling with Python and cron.

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://schooloffreelancing.com/resource-center/faqs): Answers to common questions about School Of Freelancing training programs, pricing, enrollment, Linux support services, and freelancing career outcomes.
- [How to Containerize a Legacy Web Application](https://schooloffreelancing.com/resource-center/docker-containerize): Step-by-step guide to containerizing legacy web applications with Docker and Docker Compose: Dockerfile creation, multi-stage builds, and production deployment.
- [How to Create Your First AI Chatbot](https://schooloffreelancing.com/resource-center/ai-chatbot): Step-by-step guide to building an AI chatbot using Claude API: authentication, prompt engineering, and deployment to production.
- [Linux & AI Freelancing Case Studies](https://schooloffreelancing.com/resource-center/case-studies): See real client case studies in Docker, AI, VoIP, and trading infrastructure, then get expert support to deploy reliable solutions for your business.
- [Linux Freelancing Training — Watch Page](https://schooloffreelancing.com/resource-center/intro-video): Start Your Career as a Linux Freelancer! Watch the official promotional video for the School Of Freelancing Linux Freelancing Training.
- [Resource Center](https://schooloffreelancing.com/resource-center): The School Of Freelancing Resource Center: FAQs, testimonials, case studies, an intro video, and Linux, Docker, VoIP, and AI.
- [Set Up Your Own VoIP Phone System](https://schooloffreelancing.com/resource-center/voip-setup): Complete guide to setting up FusionPBX/FreeSWITCH for a professional VoIP phone system: installation, extensions, IVR, call routing, and SIP trunking.
